item.description: The Names Opus The study of names - onomastics, is fascinating. The origins and meanings of some of my family names eluded me for years.

item.title: Preface
item.description: Preface by Peter Hoffman As a child I had no greater interest in family history and genealogy than others of my age, however, I listened to my parents’ conversations, and without effort learned - and apparently faithfully memorised - little by little, a mass of data.

item.description: The Hoffman history in Australia Our family history in Australia begins in February 1901 when Haim Yudl and his family landed at the port of Fremantle.

item.title: founders
item.description: The Founding Generation Savran: The Ancestral Home Our family’s story begins in Savran (סברן), a small town on the banks of the Lower Bug River in the Podolia Governate of the Russian Empire, in what is now the Odessa Oblast, Ukraine.
